precondition.reason: Implementation changes touch files bound by the pending R11 packet and would invalidate its authorization object.

invariants: Only docs/evidence/v1.0.0 regular JSON files are readable.
Every path segment is lstat checked and the final realpath remains inside the fixed evidence root.
Bytes are read once from an opened descriptor, bounded, hashed and parsed from the same buffer.
The output remains structureOnly until a kind-specific trusted Adapter verifies it.
Execution control is independent from signoff role coverage.
Owner and custodian authority are resolved through trusted readback and cannot be caller asserted.
Cancelled, expired, revoked or unreadable workflow state stops collection and sealing.

adapterSeams.policy: Remove DETACHED_DIGITAL_SIGNATURE_V1 from the allowlist until this Adapter exists.

invariants: A 64-hex signatureDigest is never treated as signature verification.
validationStatus, revocationStatus and condition status are derived from receipts, not trusted from the input document.
Every verified signoff binds the same executionControlDigest and source inputBindingDigest.
Acceptance Envelope binds Registry, Validator, test, execution-control, workflow-readback and evidence-verifier digests.
A matching check name without the expected App, workflow, run and SHA lineage is rejected.
PR required checks bind both the tested merge and source head without conflating them.
This Module validates normalized evidence but does not make network calls or mutate protection.

kindPolicies.HEALTH_CONTENT: Resolve each licensed instrument/version, Chinese bytes, population/scoring rules, red-flag route and human-support drill; derive configuredContentCount.
kindPolicies.PRIVACY_COMPLIANCE: Resolve H-04P approvals and same-release Candidate H-04R runtime drill separately.
kindPolicies.ACTIVITY_OPERATIONS: Resolve activity/version, publication decision, Admin principal, receipt and current runtime status; derive publishedActivityCount and reject withdrawn content.
kindPolicies.UED_HANDOFF: Resolve per-screen controlled node, route, AC, canonical states, accessibility and implementation parity; derive screenCount.
kindPolicies.PHOTOGRAPHY_RIGHTS: Hash clean master bytes and every rights field, including applicability decisions, territory, term, allowed edits and current revocation state.

invariants: Raw closureEvidence fields never reach readiness derivation without a kind-specific trusted receipt.
All receipts bind verifier Implementation and Contract digests plus evidence byte digest.
Fourteen verified Gates only derive READY_FOR_SEPARATE_FORMAL_LAUNCH_DECISION; formalLaunchAuthorized always remains false.

adversarialReview.risk: A trusted Adapter becomes a pass-through wrapper around caller input.
adversarialReview.control: Adapter receipts must bind raw readback bytes, Adapter Implementation/policy digests and negative verification outcomes; tests delete or mutate each source byte.

adversarialReview.risk: Old valid evidence is replayed after revocation.
adversarialReview.control: Formal decision requires fresh bounded revocation sequence and observedAt/validUntil checks for every revocable kind.

adversarialReview.risk: Correct digest is paired with the wrong release or environment.
adversarialReview.control: Release, environment set and subject digest are in both evidence and receipt digest domains and are compared before derivation.

adversarialReview.risk: Two individually valid remote records are mixed across runs.
adversarialReview.control: Run ID, attempt, event and SHA lineage form one exact tuple shared by checks, artifacts and protection readback.

adversarialReview.risk: A structural fixture is promoted to external proof.
adversarialReview.control: Fixture and structure-only receipts use a distinct classification rejected by Formal Gate Evidence Resolver.
